decision: The 56-question assistant slice improved from 52/56 to 55/56 with no paired regressions and identical retrieval. In the fresh full run, 451/500 tied to Stage288's candidate achieved the new best score of 451/500, +4 versus Stage287 and +5 versus Stage283. The assistant question type scored 53/56 (net +1 versus Stage287, with two candidate-only and one baseline-only answer); 0e5e2d1a and 18dcd5a5 were corrected with exact assistant citations. The fruit-and-snapper recommendation passed in the category slice but failed again in the full run, so answer-generation variance remains. Do not attribute the aggregate full-score gain to this single feature; retain the opt-in question-type scope.
limitations: Stage288 remains 34 answers below the 97% Top-20 gate. The separate 100% memory-precision target remains unmeasured; live offsite disaster-recovery restore remains unverified. Stage288 does not exercise the Stage166 stochastic-token prototype, which remains unintegrated with provider decoding and durable memory storage and has no LongMemEval accuracy A/B.
